reconstructed_captions.36: The firefighters in silver suits stand in formation as water continues to spray over them.
reconstructed_captions.37: The water spray stops, and the firefighters remain standing in their wet gear.
reconstructed_captions.38: The scene changes to a wide view of a large concrete training area with a mock aircraft fuselage.
reconstructed_captions.39: A firefighter in a silver suit walks across the training ground, carrying a long tool.
reconstructed_captions.40: The firefighter approaches a large, wet area on the ground, which appears to be covered in fuel.
reconstructed_captions.41: The firefighter stops at the edge of the fuel-covered area and prepares the ignition tool.
reconstructed_captions.42: A close-up shows the end of the ignition tool, which looks like a flare on a long pole.
reconstructed_captions.43: The firefighter holds the ignition tool out over the fuel-covered surface.
reconstructed_captions.44: With the tool in position, the firefighter prepares to ignite the fuel for the training exercise.
